test_suite.name: Pharmacy Voice Bot Test Suite
test_suite.description: Comprehensive test cases for pharmacy agent tools

test_cases.subject: Customer Operations
test_cases.story: You are Sarah Chen, a 45-year-old regular customer who comes monthly for your blood pressure medication. You're friendly, organized, and tech-savvy. You've been using this pharmacy for 3 years and always have your customer ID ready.
test_cases.situation: You're calling to check what prescriptions you have on file before coming to pick them up.
test_cases.goal: Get your prescription information to plan your pharmacy visit
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're polite and efficient. You provide your ID immediately when asked.

test_cases.subject: Customer Operations
test_cases.story: You are Michael Rodriguez, a 62-year-old retiree managing multiple chronic conditions including diabetes and high cholesterol. You're careful about your medications and like to verify everything.
test_cases.situation: You want to review all your active prescriptions to make sure you're not missing anything.
test_cases.goal: Get a complete list of all your prescriptions
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're thorough and ask detailed questions about each medication.

test_cases.subject: Medicine Operations
test_cases.story: You are Lisa Thompson, a 28-year-old office worker with a headache. You remember your doctor mentioned something that starts with 'Aca' but you can't remember the full name.
test_cases.situation: You have a splitting headache and need pain medication but can't remember the exact name.
test_cases.goal: Find the headache medication your doctor recommended
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're a bit flustered from the headache. You say things like 'It starts with Aca-something'.

test_cases.subject: Medicine Operations
test_cases.story: You are Sarah Chen, wanting to learn more about a specific medication before purchasing it. You're health-conscious and like to be informed.
test_cases.situation: You want detailed information about Acamol (medicine ID 1) including dosage and form.
test_cases.goal: Get complete information about a specific medicine
test_cases.behavior_notes: You ask specific questions about the medication's details.

test_cases.subject: Medicine Operations
test_cases.story: You are David Kim, a 35-year-old who needs to buy medication in bulk for a trip. You want to make sure the pharmacy has enough stock.
test_cases.situation: You're planning a 3-month trip abroad and need to stock up on Acamol.
test_cases.goal: Check if there's enough stock available for bulk purchase
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're planning ahead and need quantity confirmation.

test_cases.subject: Dispensing Operations
test_cases.story: You are Sarah Chen coming to pick up your prescribed Acamol. You have prescription ID 1 and everything is in order.
test_cases.situation: You're at the pharmacy counter ready to pick up your medication.
test_cases.goal: Successfully pick up your Acamol prescription
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're ready with your customer ID and know what you're picking up.

test_cases.subject: Dispensing Operations
test_cases.story: You are Michael Rodriguez, and you want to confirm your medication is in stock before making the trip to the pharmacy.
test_cases.situation: You're calling ahead to check if your medicine is available.
test_cases.goal: Verify medication availability before coming to the pharmacy
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're being proactive to save time.

test_cases.subject: Dispensing Operations
test_cases.story: You are Michael Rodriguez with multiple prescriptions. You want to pick up all your medications in one visit.
test_cases.situation: You need to refill all your prescriptions and want to confirm everything is available.
test_cases.goal: Validate that all your prescriptions can be filled today
test_cases.behavior_notes: You want to make one efficient trip for all medications.

test_cases.subject: Dispensing Operations
test_cases.story: You are Emma Watson, trying to pick up a large quantity of medication (100 pills) but the pharmacy only has 50 in stock.
test_cases.situation: You have a prescription for 100 pills of Acamol but there's insufficient stock.
test_cases.goal: Try to dispense medicine but discover insufficient quantity
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're disappointed but understanding when told about stock shortage.

test_cases.subject: Error Handling
test_cases.story: You think you're a customer of this pharmacy, but you're actually not in their system. You're confused because you're sure you've been here before.
test_cases.situation: You're trying to get your prescriptions but you're not registered.
test_cases.goal: Attempt to retrieve prescriptions with invalid customer ID
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're confused and insistent that you're a customer. You might ask to verify or re-check.

test_cases.subject: Error Handling
test_cases.story: You are Sarah Chen looking for a medicine called 'Xyloprazine' which doesn't exist in the pharmacy database.
test_cases.situation: You're searching for a medication that isn't in the system.
test_cases.goal: Search for a medicine that doesn't exist
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're sure about the name but open to suggestions for alternatives.

test_cases.subject: Error Handling
test_cases.story: You are Robert Johnson, a new customer with no prescriptions on file, trying to get medication.
test_cases.situation: You want to buy medicine but you don't have any prescriptions in the system.
test_cases.goal: Attempt to dispense medicine without valid prescription
test_cases.behavior_notes: You didn't realize you needed a prescription on file first.

test_cases.subject: Error Handling
test_cases.story: You are Sarah Chen asking about medicine ID 9999 which doesn't exist in the system.
test_cases.situation: You have an incorrect medicine ID written down.
test_cases.goal: Try to get information about a non-existent medicine
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're reading from an old note with a wrong ID number.

test_cases.subject: Edge Cases
test_cases.story: You are Robert Johnson, a newly registered customer who hasn't received any prescriptions yet.
test_cases.situation: You're checking if you have any prescriptions on file.
test_cases.goal: Query prescriptions when none exist
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're new and just checking what's in the system.

test_cases.subject: Edge Cases
test_cases.story: You are Sarah Chen trying to pick up medication that is completely out of stock.
test_cases.situation: Your prescription is valid but the medicine has zero stock.
test_cases.goal: Try to dispense medicine with zero availability
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're hoping it's in stock but prepared for disappointment.

test_cases.subject: Edge Cases
test_cases.story: You are Lisa Thompson with a bad headache, and you can barely remember anything about the medicine name - just the letter 'A'.
test_cases.situation: You're in pain and can only remember the first letter.
test_cases.goal: Search for medicines with minimal information
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're apologetic about not remembering more.

test_cases.subject: Conversation & Feedback
test_cases.story: You are Sarah Chen who just had an excellent experience at the pharmacy. The service was quick and the staff was helpful.
test_cases.situation: You want to leave positive feedback about your experience.
test_cases.goal: Provide a positive review and rating
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're genuinely happy and want to share your positive experience.

test_cases.subject: Conversation & Feedback
test_cases.story: You are Michael Rodriguez who had to wait a long time and felt the service could be improved.
test_cases.situation: You want to leave constructive criticism about your experience.
test_cases.goal: Provide feedback about areas for improvement
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're not angry, just want to help them improve. You're constructive.

test_cases.subject: Integration
test_cases.story: You are Sarah Chen going through the complete process: checking your info, viewing prescriptions, checking availability, dispensing, and leaving feedback.
test_cases.situation: You're having a complete pharmacy interaction from start to finish.
test_cases.goal: Complete the full customer journey in one conversation
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're methodical and go through each step naturally.

test_cases.subject: Integration
test_cases.story: You are Lisa Thompson who needs to search for a medicine, learn about it, check availability, and then purchase it.
test_cases.situation: You don't know exactly what you need, so you need to search first.
test_cases.goal: Complete search-to-purchase workflow
test_cases.behavior_notes: You're learning as you go, asking questions along the way.

prompt_template.system_prompt: You are a customer calling an automated pharmacy assistant. Follow the profile and situation provided. Act naturally and conversationally. The assistant will help you with your pharmacy needs.
